protocol.selectionPurpose: Diagnose failures and improve software. Never report selection as final quality.
protocol.heldoutRule: Do not change prompts, fixtures or acceptance rules after inspecting heldout outputs. Report every failure.
protocol.equalInputs: Both arms receive the same goal, real observation fixture, required feature and fixed acceptance checks. No repository editing or production deployment is claimed.
acceptance: The selected evidence ID must exactly match the supplied observation.
The delivered JSON artifact must pass fixed goal.policy.acceptance checks.
For UNTIL, an independent verifier must pass, a local candidate must publish and the audit chain must validate.
For direct, the same artifact checks are run after the response; a model claim of done has no effect.
limitations: Small structured digital-deliverable fixtures, not software engineering or business-outcome benchmarks.
Recorded real-observation fixtures are not new customer interviews.
Direct is a same-model single-response baseline, not a competitor product.
No claim about hosted model quality, team replacement, ROI or production safety.
Local provider charges are zero; hardware and electricity costs are not measured.
